content: {"episode_id":"ep-05016","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Medical necessity review is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), denied under CO-197 because required prior authorization was not obtained. The patient has recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as the underlying etiology. Telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. The study aims to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management given the high risk of thromboembolic complications."}
